BMA resident doctors' dispute in England over pay and jobs — timeline:
- 2025: three rounds of five-day strikes — 25-30 July, 14-19 October, 17-22 December 2025
- 7-13 April 2026: six-day strike
- 15-19 June 2026: further strike action
- Resident doctors in England voted on the Government's latest offer on pay and jobs in a referendum running until midday on Friday 26 June 2026.
- The BMA said further strikes would be announced for July if no progress was made.

STATUS: No confirmed July 2026 strike dates found in approved sources. UNCONFIRMED — do not assert July strike action.
